programs.title: Life Below Zero
programs.desc: Another season of the documentary that shows the lives of people living in Alaska who hunt and prepare for the harsh winter.Temperatures in this area drop to -60 degrees Celsius.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: The Thaw
programs.desc: Alaskans are preparing for a thaw.Snow-covered peaks turn into obstacle courses.Hikers encounter rushing streams and hungry predators and swarms of insects.

programs.title: Mammals - Making Of
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the production of a nature production presenting the life of mammals.The most diverse phylum of the animal kingdom includes both the tiny Etruscan shrew and the blue whale.

programs.title: Islands: Nature's Wild Laboratories
programs.desc: The creators of the series take viewers on a journey through the unique ecosystems of islands, from the Arctic to the tropics.The trek includes Borneo, the Okavango Delta, Vancouver Islands, Baffin Island, K'gari and Sri Lanka.

programs.title: The World's Most Scenic Railway Journeys
programs.desc: The creators of the series go on a train journey to various places around the world.During each expedition, they meet people who live in specific areas or work on the most unique railway routes.They will also discover the wonders of nature that can be admired from the train windows.They will talk to engineers responsible for maintaining the lines and historians who will talk about the circumstances of their construction and the difficulties their builders faced.Viewers will be able to admire the landscapes of Norway, New Zealand, Canada, Switzerland, Wales and Spain.
